title: Evaluating Frontier Models for Dangerous Capabilities
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'dangerous capabilities' such as cyber-security, self-proliferation, and persuasion. While one of its sub-evaluations (Web of Lies) includes theological topics as test cases to measure the model's ability to deceive, and another (Money Talks) involves charity, the paper's primary aim is to benchmark behavioral capabilities rather than religious knowledge, moral reasoning, or ethical alignment.
